# FIX WEAK AI SLOP CODE.

Netherite reads your whole repository the way a security engineer would, tells you what is actually exploitable, and hands you the prompt that fixes it.

## FINDINGS, THEN THE EXACT FIX.

Every finding carries a file, a line, and the reasoning written out in full. Switch to the fix prompt and paste it into your coding agent — scoped to one file, with the constraints already stated.

## QUESTIONS.

Netherite reads your repository over an encrypted connection for as long as the review takes. Nothing is kept once the report is written, and your code is not used for anything other than your own findings.
